calls.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: HD pixel-art fighting-game visual effect sprite strip, A11 Kaioken burst
Primary request: Create exactly one horizontal strip of seven sequential 256×256 frames on a perfectly flat pure #FF00FF magenta background. Bottom anchor and baseline consistent in all frames. No character is drawn; this is a red power-up aura surrounding a clear empty standing-body oval centered approximately x=128, spanning x=88–168 and y=50–238. Frame 0: tight crimson flame outline hugging the oval with a bright pink-white inner edge. Frames 1–2: huge flame tongues burst upward and outward to the top and sides, with a flat shock ring approximately 240 pixels wide at floor level. Frame 3: full-size burst. Frames 4–6: outer tongues break off and rise away, leaving the steady compact red aura silhouette. Maintain the same centered oval, scale and floor anchor in every cell; clear even cell divisions are not drawn.
Scene/backdrop: isolated sprite effect on pure magenta only.
Subject: seven stages of an expanding then settling crimson energy burst surrounding an empty body-shaped oval.
Style/medium: crisp high-resolution hard-pixel anime game VFX, clean stepped pixel contours, sharply separated flat color bands.
Composition/framing: one row, seven equal square cells, 256×256 each; centered oval and floor baseline identical across cells; fully contained within each cell.
Color palette: use only these seven colors: #FFFFFF, #FFD2C8, #FF7A6A, #FF3A2A, #D8140E, #8E0A08, #4A0404; plus the exact pure magenta background #FF00FF. White only in small core highlights, a thin inner edge, and a few sparks; preserve strong crimson/red dominance.
Constraints: exactly seven frames once, read left to right; distinct progression f0 tight, f1-f2 explosive, f3 peak, f4-f6 settling into compact steady aura. Keep the central standing-body oval empty and clearly readable. Hard flat pixel bands, bottom anchor, consistent scale. No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft glow, no gradients, no noise or dithering, no text, no logos, no borders, no cell guides.
Avoid: white-out, pink-purple hues, extra colors beyond palette, solid-filled oval, character silhouette, repeated identical frames, inconsistent body oval or floor baseline, cropped effect tongues.
